dialogue.origin: （時間になったら始めますね。よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (We'll start when it's time. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。よろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。よろしかったら初めに、性別と年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I’m the counselor. If it’s alright, could you start by telling me your gender and age?

dialogue.origin: 17歳女です
dialogue.content: I’m a 17-year-old female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: ネットで悪口を言われて傷ついています
dialogue.content: I'm hurt because people are saying mean things about me online.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: お話に来てくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming to talk about this.

dialogue.origin: お話しできる範囲でいいので、詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about it, just what you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.origin: Twitterで呟くと、黙れとかお前が言うなとか言ってくるひとがいます
dialogue.content: When I tweet, there are people who say things like 'shut up' or 'you're one to talk'.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...それは傷ついてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must be very hurtful.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: おつらい状況だと思いますが睡眠やお食事はとれていますか？...
dialogue.content: I imagine this is a difficult situation for you. Have you been able to sleep and eat properly?

dialogue.origin: 食欲はあまりないように思います
dialogue.content: I don’t think I have much of an appetite.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 今の状況はいつごろから、ですか？
dialogue.content: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.origin: 半年くらい前です
dialogue.content: About six months ago.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...長いですよね
dialogue.content: I see... That’s a long time.

dialogue.origin: 誰かに相談はしていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.origin: していません
dialogue.content: No, I haven’t.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...それなのに、今日は来てくれたんですね
dialogue.content: I see... And yet, you came to talk today.

dialogue.origin: 初めて相談してみました
dialogue.content: This is the first time I've tried talking to someone about it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...いままで、ひとりで抱えてきたんですね..
dialogue.content: I see... So you've been dealing with this all by yourself until now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: つらかったですね...
dialogue.content: That must have been very hard.

dialogue.origin: 我慢強いんですね...
dialogue.content: You've been enduring a lot...

dialogue.origin: 今日は我慢せずに、お話してもらえたら、うれしいです
dialogue.content: I would be glad if you could speak freely today without holding back.

dialogue.origin: なんで人は傷つくことを平気でひとに言うんですか？
dialogue.content: Why do people say such hurtful things to others so easily?

dialogue.origin: そうですね..そうおもいますよね
dialogue.content: Yes, it makes you wonder, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 楽しくお話しすればいいのに
dialogue.content: It would be so much better if everyone could just have a pleasant conversation.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 知らない人にとやかく言われたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to be criticized by a stranger.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...
dialogue.content: That’s understandable...

dialogue.origin: 理不尽極まりないですよね...
dialogue.content: It's completely unreasonable...

dialogue.origin: でも感情的になると余計に過激になったら困ると思って我慢してます
dialogue.content: But I'm holding back because I'm worried they'll become even more aggressive if I get emotional.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...それは苦しいですよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must be painful.

dialogue.origin: 相手から言われ放題で...感情を吐き出したいですよね
dialogue.content: Just having to take whatever they say... you must want to let out your feelings.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいんですかね
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうですね...一緒に考えましょうね
dialogue.content: Right... let's think about it together.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 相手に言い返すこともせず、きちんと論理的に考えて、決して衝動的にならなくて...
dialogue.content: You haven’t snapped back at them; you’re thinking things through logically and not acting impulsively...

dialogue.origin: あなたはまだ１７歳、本当に聡明なんだなんだと思います
dialogue.content: You're only 17, but I think you're truly wise.

dialogue.origin: これ以上傷を広げないように、あなたの心を守るために何がいいのか...一生懸命考えたいです。
dialogue.content: I want to think hard about what we can do to protect your heart and prevent you from being hurt any further.

dialogue.origin: でも言われっぱなしで悔しいです
dialogue.content: But it’s frustrating to just keep taking it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: そう思うのはもっともだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's perfectly natural to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 状況をよく知りたいので、少し質問してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: To better understand the situation, may I ask a few questions?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: Twitterで書かれるようになったのは、なにかきっかけがあったのですか？
dialogue.content: Was there something that triggered these comments on Twitter?

dialogue.origin: わかりません。半年前からTwitterを始めました
dialogue.content: I don't know. I started using Twitter six months ago.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...はじめてすぐ、ですか？
dialogue.content: I see... Did it start right after you joined?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 相手は思い当たりますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea who they might be?

dialogue.origin: 知らないひとです
dialogue.content: It's someone I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そうですか..気味が悪いですよね
dialogue.content: I see... That's creepy, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 怖いです
dialogue.content: It’s scary.

dialogue.origin: そうですね...
dialogue.content: Yes, it is...

dialogue.origin: あなたはどんな風に対応しているんですか？
dialogue.content: How have you been responding?

dialogue.origin: たまにブロックしたりしていますけど、ブロックしたらブロックすんな！って別のアカウントにかえてまた言ってきたりするので最近は無視してます
dialogue.content: I sometimes block them, but then they just switch to a different account and say, "Don't block me!" and come at me again, so lately I've just been ignoring them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...随分執拗ですね
dialogue.content: I see... That’s quite persistent.

dialogue.origin: 別に悪いこと書いてないと思うんですけど、、
dialogue.content: I don't think I'm posting anything bad, though...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね..主に、どんな話題なんですか？
dialogue.content: I understand... What kinds of topics do you mainly post about?

dialogue.origin: 好きなアイドルの話が中心です
dialogue.content: Mostly about my favorite idols.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに...だれが、押しなんですか
dialogue.content: By the way... who’s your favorite?

dialogue.origin: 推し、でした。
dialogue.content: I meant your ‘oshi’ (favorite member).

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい
dialogue.content: Sorry about that.

dialogue.origin: ジャニーズのキンプリです
dialogue.content: King & Prince from Johnny’s.

dialogue.origin: そうですか！人気ですよね
dialogue.content: Oh, I see! They're very popular, aren't they?

dialogue.origin: 推しがいるのは、充実しますよね
dialogue.content: Having a group to stan makes life more fulfilling, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: ....なのに、台無しにされてしまいますよね...
dialogue.content: ...And yet, this person is ruining it for you...

dialogue.origin: はい！一緒に推し活できる友達作りたかったのでTwitter始めたんです！
dialogue.content: Yes! I started Twitter to make friends who I could fangirl with!

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お友達はできましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you been able to make any friends?

dialogue.origin: 何人かできました！でも、なんか同担無理！みたいな独占欲強い子もいるし、、、
dialogue.content: I've made a few! But there are also some possessive people who are like, "I can't deal with people who stan the same idol!"...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...いろいろな人がいますよね
dialogue.content: I see... It takes all sorts of people, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、そうゆう子が悪口言ってきてるのかも
dialogue.content: Maybe those kinds of people are the ones saying the mean things.

dialogue.origin: そうですね...
dialogue.content: Possibly...

dialogue.origin: その可能性も考えられますよね...
dialogue.content: That’s a possibility to consider.

dialogue.origin: みんな仲良くできたらいいのに
dialogue.content: I wish everyone could just get along.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそうですよね、
dialogue.content: That's absolutely true.

dialogue.origin: 嫌なことを言ってくる人は...
dialogue.content: As for the people who say hurtful things...

dialogue.origin: どんな頻度なんですか？
dialogue.content: How often does it happen?

dialogue.origin: 私が呟いたら毎回反応してくる感じです。
dialogue.content: It feels like they respond every time I tweet.

dialogue.origin: そうですか..う.～ん...つらいですね
dialogue.content: I see... Hmm... That’s tough.

dialogue.origin: 私のことが気に食わないんですかね？
dialogue.content: Do they just not like me?

dialogue.origin: そう感じるんですね...
dialogue.content: That’s how it feels to you...

dialogue.origin: そう思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It's natural that you would think that.

dialogue.origin: いちいち反応してくるし、うざいです
dialogue.content: They react to every little thing, and it's so annoying.

dialogue.origin: そうですね...かなり鬱陶しいですよね
dialogue.content: Yes... that must be very irritating.

dialogue.origin: 日常生活には影響ないですか？
dialogue.content: Is it affecting your daily life?

dialogue.origin: 学校でもたまに思い出して落ち込むときはあります
dialogue.content: Sometimes I remember it at school and feel down.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...精神的にやられてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see... It must be taking a mental toll on you.

dialogue.origin: 少しお話を整理してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I summarize what I’ve heard so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 半年前にTwitterを始めてから、好きなアイドルの話題を楽しくしたいのに、毎回悪口を言ってくる人がいる。みんなで楽しく仲良くしたいのに、ブロックしてみたりもしたが、アカウント変えてくるし、余計ややこしくなるので、最近は無視して我慢しているが、言われ放題で辛い
dialogue.content: You started using Twitter six months ago because you wanted to have fun talking about your favorite idols, but there's someone who says malicious things every time you post. You want everyone to have fun and get along, and you've tried blocking them, but they just come back with a different account, which makes things more complicated. So lately, you've been ignoring them and putting up with it, but it's hard having to take whatever they say.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいか...落ち込むことが多く、今日お話にきてくれた
dialogue.content: You're not sure what to do... you've been feeling down a lot, and that's why you came to talk today.

dialogue.origin: そんな感じです
dialogue.content: That’s about right.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね..どうして人を傷つけることを言ってくるのか...理解できないすよね
dialogue.content: I see... It's hard to understand why someone would say such hurtful things...

dialogue.origin: はい。理解できません
dialogue.content: Yes. I can’t understand it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...
dialogue.content: Of course...

dialogue.origin: もしかすると、やきもちかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: It might be jealousy.

dialogue.origin: やきもちですか？！
dialogue.content: Jealousy?!

dialogue.origin: そんな感じがします...
dialogue.content: That’s the sense I get...

dialogue.origin: 楽しそうで、友好的なあなたが羨ましいのかも
dialogue.content: They might be envious of how you seem to be having fun and are so friendly.

dialogue.origin: 好きなアイドルを一緒に推したいってだけなのに
dialogue.content: All I want to do is stan my favorite idol with others.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね....よくわかります
dialogue.content: I know... I understand completely.

dialogue.origin: やっかみ、とか、八つ当たりとか
dialogue.content: It could be envy, or them taking their frustrations out on you.

dialogue.origin: あくまで相手の問題、なんでしょうけど...
dialogue.content: Ultimately, it's their problem, but...

dialogue.origin: メンタル参ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: ...it really takes a toll on your mental health.

dialogue.origin: みんなで仲良くしようって気持ちがダメんですかねー
dialogue.content: Is it wrong for me to want everyone to get along?

dialogue.origin: いえ、そうではなくて
dialogue.content: No, that's not it.

dialogue.origin: 羨ましいのかもしれないですけど
dialogue.content: They may be feeling envious, but...

dialogue.origin: あなたがとっても友好的で、すてきだから..
dialogue.content: it's because you are so friendly and wonderful...

dialogue.origin: でも、とんだとばっちり、ですよね
dialogue.content: But you're unfairly caught in the crossfire, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: あなたは、どうしたいですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to do?

dialogue.origin: せっかく作ったアカウントなので、これからも続けていきたいんですけど、傷つきたくはないです
dialogue.content: I put effort into making the account, so I want to keep it going, but I don’t want to keep getting hurt.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...これ以上傷つくのはとっても心配です
dialogue.content: I understand... I'm very worried about you getting hurt any more.

dialogue.origin: あなたが優しいので、余計に傷つけられてしまいそうに感じます
dialogue.content: Because you’re so kind, I worry you might be hurt even more.

dialogue.origin: 例えばですが...周りに、相談できそうな人はいますか？
dialogue.content: For example... Is there anyone around you whom you could talk to?

dialogue.origin: うーん。推し活専用アカを身近なひとには言ってないんですよ
dialogue.content: Hmm. I haven't told anyone I know in real life about my fan account.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: だから、バレたくないとゆうか
dialogue.content: So I kind of don’t want it to be found out.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。よくわかります
dialogue.content: That's understandable. I get it.

dialogue.origin: たとえばですが...スクールカウンセラーの先生はいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: For instance... how about the school counselor?

dialogue.origin: あー、いますね
dialogue.content: Ah, we do have one.

dialogue.origin: あなたの秘密は厳守してくれると思うのですが
dialogue.content: I believe they would strictly keep your confidentiality.

dialogue.origin: それなら言ってもいいかもです
dialogue.content: In that case, I might be able to talk to them.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。少し安心しました
dialogue.content: I see. I'm a little relieved to hear that.

dialogue.origin: あなたの大切な世界を傷つけられないように、味方になってくれるのではないかと思います
dialogue.content: I think they could be an ally in protecting the world that matters to you from being harmed.

dialogue.origin: １回相談してみます
dialogue.content: I'll try talking to them once.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: それから
dialogue.content: And also,

dialogue.origin: もしよかったら、またお話ししに来てください
dialogue.content: if you'd like, please come and talk to me again.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: いろいろな方法を、一緒に考えたいです。今日は来てくれてありがとうございました。これで終了しても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: I'd like to think about various options together with you. Thank you for coming today. Is it okay if we end the session here?

dialogue.origin: はい、また相談にきます
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll come back for another session.

dialogue.origin: お待ちしております。応援していますね。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: I’ll be here when you’re ready. I’m rooting for you. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （これでロープレを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (May we end the role-play here?)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。終了していただいて構いません）
dialogue.content: (Good work. Thank you. It's fine to end it now.)

dialogue.origin: （長引いてしまい、すみませんでした。勉強になりました。また機会がありましたらよろしくお願いします。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry it ran a bit long. It was a great learning experience. I hope we can do this again. Thank you.)

topic.sub: ネット上での悪口によるメンタルダメージ
